title: Repair hazard/poison/disease/trap source procedures and selected stateful capabilities
description:
Repair known hazard/poison/disease/trap projection defects: success branches, variants,
Sphere of Annihilation, detection/trigger/disarm/geometry, recurrence/progression/cure/
immunity/termination, and harvesting-versus-target-effect distinctions. Preserve
source/procedure relationships for discovery; deterministic state transitions remain
required where state is actually mutated.
design: 2026-10-10 DESIGN (Claude Captain, main 52e7e19b). Lane A, profile rules-clause-complete. SEQUENCING: after PR #649 (eshyra-o9bd.19.3.1) merges, because it introduces the hazard data.variants shape this reuses. Population check: of 25 hazard records, only hazard:sphere-of-annihilation has no mechanics; every other trap projects saves/damage/conditions; F-01 success branches repaired by PR #567. F-23 (sphere-prose): the trap prints (a) 'A successful DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check reveals that the mouth contains a sphere of annihilation that can't be controlled or moved' -> mechanics.checks [{ability:'intelligence', skill:'arcana', dc:20, purpose verbatim}] using the existing check grammar/shape (find how other traps project detection checks; reuse it); (b) 'It is otherwise identical to a normal sphere of annihilation' -> a discovery relationship to magic-item:sphere-of-annihilation through the existing record-relationship declaration mechanism (recordRelationships.ts manifest) with the uncontrollable/immovable qualifier kept verbatim, not a copied item projection; (c) the optional sympathy enchantment -> a data.variants entry (shape from #649) whose mechanics carry the dispel (spell:dispel-magic, DC 18) and a relationship to spell:antipathy-sympathy (sympathy aspect), all values verbatim. Consumers: grep hazard mechanics/relationship consumers first. CAP-006 (hazard-and-healing-potion, 'procedures are complete') and indep:007 (hazard-completeness, 'deterministically executable') -> narrowed under ADR 0020 (no completeness/execution claim; surviving obligation: emitted hazard and potion projections agree with source; healing potion's typed table-driven healing already projected). F-01 -> accepted with reasoning citing PR #567 + census. Evidence: exact sphere-trap projection test + relationship resolution assertion; no per-hazard tests.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known hazard-family source-fidelity defects are repaired against source evidence.
- Source-defined variants remain separately addressable and option-local.
- Independently enumerable printed branches/fields cannot silently disappear.
- Pack data consumed by a capability in force is source-faithful; that capability's contract, execution, and state evidence belong to the capability lane (eshyra-o9bd.19.5 / eshyra-olc5).
- The bead does not require every hazard to be an end-to-end deterministic state machine.
